lines.en: Leaps lightly in snow
Slips under ice unseen
Skims snowfields silently
Moves in moonlit shadows
Travels in falling snow
Swiftly darts in cold wind
Leaves a faint shadow in snow
Mysteriously leaps in snow
Creeps in deep snow
Jumps lightly in snowfield
One push off the snow carries me far.
The ice crust cracks under my feet.
Gazes at the stars in snow
Stands silently in snow
Shivers in the cold wind
Stands still in snow
Stares into the snow
Breathes softly in the cold
Stands quietly in the snow
Paces slowly in the snow
Remains still in the snow
Considers in the snow
I shake the snow off my back.
I tuck my claws into my fur.
A snowflake lands on my nose.
I listen for movement under the snow.
Notices the player

lines.zh: 雪壳一响，我的耳朵就转向你。
lines.en: At the crunch of snow crust, my ears turn to you.

lines.zh: 雪地上你冒的热气，我盯住了。
lines.en: I've fixed on the heat rising off you.
Stares at the player
Tracks the player
On this snowfield, only you are moving.

lines.zh: 我在雪堆后面，只露出鼻尖。
lines.en: Behind the drift, only my nose shows.
Beneath the snow I've tensed my hind legs.
Observes the player
Player in sight
Your boots crushed the snow crust.
The snow cannot hide your warmth.
Don't chase me. I'm faster.
I am waiting for you to come closer.
Your shadow is printed on the snow.
This snowfield is mine.
You crunch the snow too loudly.
I caught the scent of something alive.
In the snow, my legs gave out.
Even the lightest snow-leap can fall.
Cut by ice blades!
Got frostburned.
Claw damage.
Fall damage.
Broken wings!
Hit by ice!

lines.zh: 雪里一跳摔了，翅膀沾满冰碴。
lines.en: I slip mid-hop; ice crusts my wings.

lines.zh: 落地时翅膀折了，我蹦不起来。
lines.en: My wing snapped on landing; I can't spring anymore.

lines.zh: 它轻盈地跃起，几乎透明的翅膀在空中划出一道弧线。
lines.en: It leaps lightly, leaving a translucent trail in the air.

lines.zh: 雪地里响起它尖细的叫声，如同夜的低语。
lines.en: Its shrill cry echoes through the snowy night.

lines.zh: 它靠近你，眼中闪烁着饥饿的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with hunger as it approaches you.

lines.zh: 你靠近它的猎物，它却悄然消失在雪中。
lines.en: As you approach its prey, it vanishes into the snow.

lines.zh: 它似乎对你并不在意，只是悄悄跟踪。
lines.en: It seems unconcerned with you, merely stalking you.

lines.zh: 你尝试靠近它，却感受到一股寒意。
lines.en: You approach it, only to feel a chill.

lines.zh: 它的目光锁定在你的身上，你感到一阵颤栗。
lines.en: Its gaze locks onto you, sending a shiver down your spine.

lines.zh: 它从雪中跃出，爪子锋利如刀。
lines.en: It leaps from the snow, its claws razor-sharp.

lines.zh: 它的身影在月光下若隐若现，如同幽灵。
lines.en: Its form flickers in the moonlight, like a ghost.

lines.zh: 你试图引诱它，却触发了它的警觉。
lines.en: You try to lure it, but trigger its alertness.

lines.zh: 雪跃者与你猛烈相撞，冰霜刺骨。
lines.en: The Snow Skipper collides with you, leaving icy shards.

lines.zh: 你被雪跃者的撞击震得摇晃不定。
lines.en: You are shaken by the Snow Skipper's collision.

lines.zh: 它一跃而起，狠狠撞向你的头部。
lines.en: It leaps and collides with your head.

lines.zh: 你试图避开雪跃者的撞击，却未能成功。
lines.en: You try to avoid the Snow Skipper's collision, but fail.

lines.zh: 冰霜凝结在雪跃者的撞击中。
lines.en: Ice forms where the Snow Skipper collides.

lines.zh: 雪跃者利用速度撞击你的防护。
lines.en: The Snow Skipper uses speed to collide with your defense.

lines.zh: 你感受到它撞击时的寒意和力量。
lines.en: You feel the cold and force of its collision.

lines.zh: 它用全身的力量撞击你，试图击溃你。
lines.en: It uses all its strength to collide with you, trying to break you.

lines.zh: 雪跃者的撞击使你身上的雪融化。
lines.en: The Snow Skipper's collision melts the snow on you.

lines.zh: 它的撞击中蕴含着致命的寒意。
lines.en: Its collision is laced with lethal cold.

lines.zh: 雪跃者发出低沉的呜咽声，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It emits a low moan, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它在雪中留下求偶的痕迹。
lines.en: It leaves mating marks in the snow.

lines.zh: 雪跃者在雪中滑行，寻找配偶。
lines.en: It slides in the snow, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它追逐着同类，发出求偶的信号。
lines.en: It chases its kind, emitting mating signals.

lines.zh: 雪跃者在月光下寻找合适的伴侣。
lines.en: The Snow Skipper searches for a mate under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它以独特的叫声吸引伴侣的注意。
lines.en: It attracts a mate with its unique call.

lines.zh: 雪跃者在雪地上留下求偶的脚印。
lines.en: It leaves mating footprints in the snow.

lines.zh: 它在雪中寻找配偶，目光充满渴望。
lines.en: It searches for a mate in the snow, its gaze full of desire.

lines.zh: 雪跃者在雪地上进行求偶仪式。
lines.en: The Snow Skipper performs a mating ritual in the snow.

lines.zh: 它在雪中等待着合适的求偶机会。
lines.en: It waits in the snow for a suitable mating opportunity.

lines.zh: 轻盈的雪片在你脚下飘落。
lines.en: Feathery snow falls beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 雪地里传来微弱的吱吱声。
lines.en: A faint squeak comes from the snow.
A corner of something emerges from the snow.

lines.zh: 雪下潜伏着什么冰冷的东西。
lines.en: Something cold lurks beneath the snow.

lines.zh: 你感觉有东西在注视着你。
lines.en: Something is watching you.

lines.zh: 雪中闪烁着诡异的光芒。
lines.en: Strange light flickers in the snow.

lines.zh: 你闻到了一股腐烂的气味。
lines.en: A foul smell reaches your nose.

lines.zh: 雪地下的生物蠢蠢欲动。
lines.en: A creature stirs beneath the snow.

lines.zh: 雪地里有一团黑色的影子。
lines.en: A black shadow in the snow.

lines.zh: 雪下传来轻微的咳嗽声。
lines.en: A faint cough comes from the snow.
One hop and I'm on you in the snow.
You hear its groan.
It slowly approaches you.
Its fangs emerge from the snow.
Its eyes fix on you.
Its form becomes clearer.
Its cold hand reaches out.
It growls softly.
Its eyes shine with greed.
Its shadow stretches.
Behind the drift, I have fixed on you.

lines.zh: 起跳之前，我先压低身子。
lines.en: I crouch low before the leap.
Your tracks lead to a dead end.
The cold wind brings me your scent.
Prey stands out on the snow crust.
I have measured this leap.
Eyes in the snow stare at you.
Its presence is near you.

lines.zh: 我从雪坡滑下来，没有声音。
lines.en: I slide down the snow slope without a sound.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中寻找你。
lines.en: Its eyes search for you in the dark.
Its voice echoes in the snow.
It advances slowly toward you.
Its cold breath is beneath the snow.
Its eyes begin to glow.
Its cold makes you tremble.

lines.zh: 它的声音在你的耳边响起。
lines.en: Its voice whispers in your ear.
My landing point is your neck.
My claws are already spread.
The snow sinks and you slow down.
One hop down the slope and I'm behind you.
The chill is gathering.

lines.zh: 你听见雪下的呼吸了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear the breathing under the snow?
On three, I pounce.

lines.zh: 雪面一弹，我已经到你身后。
lines.en: One kick off the snow and I'm behind you.

lines.zh: 它以迅雷不及掩耳之势跃起，雪片四溅。
lines.en: It leaps with such speed, sending snow flying.

lines.zh: 雪层中传来一声低吼，雪跃者准备攻击。
lines.en: A low growl comes from the snow layer as the Snow Skipper prepares to attack.

lines.zh: 它用锋利的爪子在雪地里挖掘，准备扑击。
lines.en: It digs into the snow with sharp claws, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 雪跃者化为一道白色影子，直扑过来。
lines.en: The Snow Skipper turns into a white shadow, charging forward.

lines.zh: 它的利爪划破空气，留下一道雪痕。
lines.en: Its claws slice through the air, leaving a trail of snow.

lines.zh: 雪层颤抖，雪跃者跃向猎物。
lines.en: The snow shakes as the Snow Skipper leaps toward its prey.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪烁着凶光，准备扑杀。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with a predatory light, ready to kill.

lines.zh: 雪跃者在雪中消失，只留下一串雪足迹。
lines.en: The Snow Skipper vanishes in the snow, leaving only a trail behind.

lines.zh: 它的身影在雪中一闪而过，留下一串雪足迹。
lines.en: It vanishes in the snow, leaving only a trail behind.

lines.zh: 雪跃者迅速跃起，利爪几乎抓中。
lines.en: The Snow Skipper leaps up, its claws nearly striking.
Snow sprays your face as my claws arrive!
I burst out of the drift!
This swipe goes for your legs!
Ice claws scrape your armor!
You are knocked into the snow!
Don't hope to outrun me on snow!

lines.zh: 雪跃者在寒风中低吼，准备孵化。
lines.en: The Snow Skipper growls in the cold wind, ready to hatch.

lines.zh: 雪层中传来微弱的叫声，雪跃者即将孵化。
lines.en: A weak sound comes from the snow layer as the Snow Skipper is about to hatch.

lines.zh: 雪中慢慢裂开一道口子，雪跃者即将孵化。
lines.en: A crack appears in the snow as the Snow Skipper is about to hatch.

lines.zh: 寒冷中，雪跃者的孵化声清晰可闻。
lines.en: In the cold, the sound of the Snow Skipper hatching is clear.

lines.zh: 雪跃者的孵化声打破了寂静的雪地。
lines.en: The hatching sound of the Snow Skipper breaks the silence of the snow ground.

lines.zh: 雪中裂开一道裂缝，雪跃者孵化而出。
lines.en: A crack opens in the snow as the Snow Skipper hatches.

lines.zh: 它从雪中慢慢孵化，发出微弱的声音。
lines.en: It slowly hatches from the snow, making a weak sound.

lines.zh: 寒冷中，雪跃者的叫声宣告着它的诞生。
lines.en: In the cold, the Snow Skipper’s call announces its birth.

lines.zh: 雪中突然裂开一道口子，雪跃者孵化。
lines.en: A crack suddenly opens in the snow as the Snow Skipper hatches.

lines.zh: 雪跃者在雪中孵化，微弱的叫声响起。
lines.en: The Snow Skipper hatches from the snow, a weak sound ringing out.
The drift bulges and I break out.
Scratching rises from beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 我在新雪里伸了个懒腰。
lines.en: I stretch in the fresh snow.
The blizzard carried me here.
My nose breaks the snow first.

lines.zh: 这片雪原刚换了我做主。
lines.en: This snowfield has a new master.
I climbed out of an ice crack.
The snow settles. I am awake.
My fur is singed and the snow melts!
Fall from high up!
Frozen lake splash!
Snow bomb explosion!
Hit by ice arrow!
Frozen by ice magic!
Hungry! Feed me!

lines.zh: 雷把雪照白，我的毛全焦了。
lines.en: The bolt turns the snow white and singes my fur.
Void fall!
